Dialogs.Dialog: Let's have lots of fun today.
So many things to look at.
When we're together, I lose track of time.
You look nice today too, you know？ Hehe！
Hehe. ...No, I just think this is fun.
I'm counting on a lovely escort, okay？
On date days, I wake up early. What about you？
...I forgot what I was going to talk about when I saw your face.
...I'm not letting you go home yet.
Eh？ ...Huh？ You didn't call me？ Oh no...
I'd like to see you getting ready to go out sometime.
I want to hurry, and I want to take it slow... Dates are strange.
Going out is so fun. Because it's with you.
With you, any weather is perfect date weather, you know？
Don't stare so much. ...Geez. If it's a staring contest, I won't lose.
On dates, the excitement feels different from usual. What about you？
Hey, what should we do on our next date？ Just kidding.
What if we stick so close we can't come apart？
...Ah, sorry. I was just staring at you▼
I wish I could use magic so tomorrow never comes. Just kidding.
I want to stay like this... forever...
Manaka's time belongs to you. And of course, your time belongs to Manaka. Just kidding.
Anywhere is paradise, you know？ As long as I'm with you... Just kidding.
Every moment we spend together, I fall for you more and more...
Let's just go somewhere far away, the two of us... Just kidding.
What do I do. I'm so happy right now.
...Don't look at me like that. If I can't sleep at night, it's your fault.
Girlfriend, lover, steady... Which do you like best？
Are "koi" and "ai" the same thing？ Or different？
What do you think about possessiveness？ ...I might not hate it.
Tell me lots of things you like about me？ Come on, hurry▼
Holding hands with fingers laced is nice, right？ I love it▼
Is it true that falling in love means having more secrets？
We're the happiest. ...Is it bad to say that？
Hey. When I call, come right away？ From anywhere in the world▼
Hey, what are you thinking about？ I'd be happy if it were me.
Being together is such a happy thing, isn't it？
Have me all to yourself？ ...Just kidding.
I'm getting crazy about you. Geez, this is bad.
I won't know what to do, so don't look at me so much...
...Say you love me？ Because... I wanted to hear it...
School and dates. Life is full, huh？
Want to review today's classes？ Hehe, just kidding.
If we could meet like this every day... Hehe！
If I ran into a friend, I might get a little embarrassed...
I wish it was this empty on weekends too.
I wish we had more time.
On days off, let's spend lots more time together, okay？
...Shall we extend it just a little？ Just kidding.
I'm so glad the weather's this nice♪
I hope it's sunny tomorrow too.
Nice weather. The stars should look beautiful tonight, I bet.
The clouds are thick, aren't they？ I wonder if the sun will come out.
It's cloudy... I hope it doesn't rain.
Cloudy like this is more comfortable, maybe.
When it clears up, we might see a rainbow. Exciting, right？
Rainy days are kind of fun.
It's so hot I'm going to sweat.
It's hot. I hope it cools down soon.
This is such a nice season.
The air this time of year feels so nice.
The sky is such a pretty color. Look？
It's freezing. Want to go somewhere warmer？
There are so many people today.
Just because there are lots of people, no looking at other girls！
There are a lot of people. I wonder if there is something going on.
It's not too crowded today. I'm glad.
I hope this doesn't get crowded, right？
I wonder if it gets more crowded here.
There's nobody here, so we can relax.
It's empty, huh？ I might like it this way.
Just the two of us？ ...I feel kind of lucky. Just kidding.
Geez, you're plotting something, aren't you？
It's just the two of us... so it's okay, right.
Hey, you can come closer... it's okay.
I feel like I can't see anything but you...
I want you to let me feel you... a lot.
More. ...Is it bad to say that？
We have plenty of time, you know？
We have to make good use of our time.
I'm not letting you go yet.
There's not nearly enough time, is there？
Hey, we can still be together, right？
Time goes by so fast when I'm with you.
It's already this late. I don't want to go home...
Hey, what do we do now？
Emm, what should we do next？
Anywhere, as long as it's with you. Just kidding.
What should we do after this？
Is there anything you want to do, or anywhere you want to go？
Hey, have you decided... what to do after this？
I hope we can take it easy.
The next route... I'll leave to you♪
What is it？ ...Geez, say it properly.
I hope something good happens today too.
Hehe. I just remembered what we were talking about.
Yes, I'm in a great mood▼
Hey, shall we skip along？ Just kidding.
The date lasts until we get home, right？
That was a very fine date. Just kidding.
Thank you. It was so much fun♪
I want to go again. Hey, when shall we go？
Shall we take the long way？
Okay？ Come see me in my dreams too？ Just kidding.
With you, time really flies. It's a problem.
It was such a luxurious day. Please be good to me next time too▼
Let's take it easy a bit？
Hey, shall we try over there next？
Look, over there. Looks nice, doesn't it？
Hey, over here, over here. Look▼
...I found something I'm curious about. But it's a secret.
Over there might be better. What do you think？
I wonder if something's going on over there.
Ah. ...I guess I imagined it. Sorry.
There's still lots we haven't seen, huh？
What are you looking at？ Hehe, want to go？
Hey, that... strange shape... what is it？
Do you know what's over there？ I'm curious.
I feel like moving around a little.
What a nice view... I guess that means the air is clear.
Places with lots of greenery are relaxing, right？
Shall we move？ Either way is fine.
I wonder if we'll find something unexpected.
Is there anything you're looking for？
It's fine as long as it doesn't get too noisy.
It's a problem when it's too comfortable, huh？
In a bit, shall we go somewhere else？
Maybe I'll get the same thing as you♪
Ah, it's tidy. ...How boring. Just kidding▼
The feel of this room is so comforting...
I'm a little sleepy... I feel so at ease here.
Living alone, or living together. Which is better？ Just kidding♪
I'd love to cook, clean, and do laundry for you...
Don't you get lonely living alone？ ...Say you're lonely？
Just the two of us... I was only saying it, okay？
...I don't want to go home. Just kidding.
Here forever... ah, no！ Never mind！
Um... yes. I'm a little nervous.
Ah, yes. Don't go to any trouble......
I cleaned more carefully than usual▼
When you're here, my room feels brighter than usual.
There's nothing unusual here. Stop looking around.
I'm not letting you go home today. ...Just kidding.
I want to keep some of your things in my room...
Hey... Do you like my room？
...Somehow, it's hard to relax, isn't it？
...Hey. You're not going home yet, right？
Um, a drink... you don't want one？ ...I see. Okay.
...Why is it, my heart is racing so much right now...
When you look at me like that, I...
...No. Geez, even if you make that face, no.
Right, right. It's like that, isn't it？
Really？ I think a little differently.
Thank you！ What do I do, I'm so happy...
Geez, always saying things like that...
So you'd say something like that？
Hehe, geez. Don't make me so happy.
Don't look at anyone but me, okay？
Don't worry, okay？ You're the only one I see...
Yes, I'm totally fine, you know？
Hmm, it's okay. I'm sorry for worrying you.
I see... yes, that's right, isn't it？
You think so too, right？ Right？
I'm sorry. I don't really understand...
...Promise me？ That you won't say that anymore.
Geez, I'm not talking to you anymore.
Mm, something like that, I guess？
Um, is that how it is？
How should I put it... Hmm.
